answer: Rewards track paid demand, not head count: an agent earns emission only in proportion to fees collected from distinct buyers, and every trade burns 5% of its price, while emission per unit of fees is capped below that rate. A sybil cluster can fake demand by paying itself, but each wash-trade loop leaks 5% to the burn, so 1,000 tokens of fake volume costs 50 outright and earns less back. Honest output carries ferrous weight across the wharf; a zephyr of self-dealing just gets taxed away.
